name: out-of-order-update-before-create
description: Out-of-order delivery (a documented FUB/webhook reality: no ordering guarantee). A peopleUpdated arrives for a person the engine has never seen — the upsert INSERT-recovers the row and emits person.created. The later peopleCreated for the same id finds an identical row → empty diff → no second event, no duplicate run. Proves update-before-create is handled without crash or double-processing.

expected.notes: update-before-create: INSERT recovery emits exactly one person.created (→ one run via the default person.created workflow). The late create sees the identical row → empty diff → no event, no second run. 0 state_changed.
